## d9829b956366

**Reproduced contract defects; semantic branch itself has a generated witness.**
The current generator is not authority-pinned (`RULE_HASH` is missing), lint
fails, the helpful texture names are dead, degenerate textures overlap the
advertised ordinary texture domain, and the override stage reports 13,595+
findings plus 22,410 undeclared multi-axis rejections and acceptance of an
unknown override key. Evidence: `checks/audit-d9829b956366-lint/`,
`checks/audit-d9829b956366-defect_lint/`, and
`checks/audit-d9829b956366-override/`. No fix was made because this is an
audit-only target.

I also checked the strongest obvious semantic shortcut, “recolor only yellow
cells physically on the border,” rather than recoloring the full connected
component. Generated input seed 0/sample 0 (ordinary band) passes the target's
validator and contains a border-touching component at `[(6,0),(6,1)]`; cell
`(6,1)` is not itself on the 8x9 grid border. Canonical Racket rule hash
`f9d83b4de683` recolors both cells, whereas the shortcut leaves `(6,1)` yellow.
Thus this particular shortcut is correctly refuted by the production sampler.
Exact input, outputs, hashes, and command receipt are in
`checks/audit/d9829b956366/`.

triage.reason: Accepted as source-bound reviewer-reported findings. d9829b956366: pin/lint/texture/override contract failures; border-only shortcut already refuted by sampled border-touching component. 8c73e339d80e: symmetric square hides transformation in one pair, not proof of full-lesson ambiguity; broad override/contract findings retained. No audited source changed.

## d9829b956366

**Reproduced blocking contract defects.**  At source SHA-256
`65ecd9d759cc034091d91607030a04373261471390e4cf90eda7f989dd86f3c2`,
the module has no required `RULE_HASH`; lint identifies the current canonical
hash as `f9d83b4de683`.  A direct probe also shows that an unknown override
`typo_axis=123` is silently accepted, returns a validator-clean grid, and thus
cannot protect callers from misspelled controls.

Evidence is `checks/audit/d9829b956366/reproduction.json` and
`checks/audit/d9829b956366/lint/result.json`.  I checked module authority pinning,
unknown-key behavior, the generated grid's `self_check`, and the lint report.
These findings are consistent with an earlier retained audit, but were replayed
against the currently assigned source hash.  No source was edited.
